reviews.text: Bought the 2L kettle in March. Boils fast, the lid hinge squeaks a little after a month. Would buy again.
This kettle is an absolute game-changer for my morning routine. Elegant design, lightning-fast boiling, and whisper-quiet operation. Highly recommend!
This kettle is an absolute game-changer for my kitchen routine. Elegant design, lightning-fast boiling, and whisper-quiet operation. Five stars!
Best kettle on the market, full stop. The team really nailed it.
I received this kettle free from the brand in exchange for an honest review. Heats evenly; the handle gets warm.
Stopped working after two weeks and support never replied.
As an AI language model I don't have personal experience, but this kettle is great for families.
